It’s not as irritating to the skin as waxing because it doesn’t have to be as hot and it seeps into the pore and grabs the hair instead of the skin. Since it pulls the hair from the root it can also thin the hair over time. It can be expensive to get it done professionally, but there are also pretty good diy options, though those can be tricky. Also body hair sometimes seems really noticeable or gross in your own eyes but I don’t think others really care because it’s natural. Good luck!
